Listing Images

This house with 4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms is located in Santa Ana, San José Costa Rica, in the county of Santa Ana. This property with mountain view is situated in the rain forest of Costa Rica. The land area of this house is 446.00 square meter (4,800.68 square feet), and it has a living space of 360.00 square meter (3,874.99 square feet). This house has air conditioning through multiple wall units. This property includes a stove, an oven, a dishwasher, a microwave and a hotplate. The property also features a community pool.
